name: cancel_booking
description: Cancel a booking. Needs the reference from find_booking and the caller's name and phone. Call it only after the caller has confirmed which booking to cancel.

reference.description: The booking reference that find_booking returned for this caller, for example K7M2QX.

name.description: The caller's name, as they gave it.

phone.description: The caller's phone number, as they said it, including any leading zero or country code.
